narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four and nine are not co-prime, because neither of them is a prime number.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>But co-prime asks only about common factors, and it says nothing about the numbers being prime.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We must list the factors of both numbers and look for a shared one.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>List the factors of both numbers. If the only shared factor is one, the numbers are co-prime.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Are eight and nine co-prime, and are six and eight co-prime?
